scope.exclusionReason: These topics appear in the supplement but belong to ATA 31 Indicating/Recording rather than FCOM DSC-23 Communications.

C23-001.question: Which systems provide internal communication on the aircraft?
C23-001.answer: The flight, cabin, and service interphones, plus the passenger address system
C23-001.explanation: Internal communication is provided by the flight, cabin, and service interphones and by the passenger address system.
C23-001.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-10 · PDF p.1062 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx pp.9, 10

C23-002.question: Which means can provide external communication in voice or data mode?
C23-002.answer: VHF or HF radio and, when installed, SATCOM
C23-002.explanation: The FCOM identifies VHF/HF radio and optional SATCOM as external communication paths for voice or data.
C23-002.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-10 · PDF p.1062 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx pp.10, 11

C23-003.question: Which Radio Management Panel functions in the emergency electrical configuration?
C23-003.explanation: Only RMP 1 functions in the emergency electrical configuration.
C23-003.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-20 · PDF p.1064 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.12

C23-004.question: If one RMP fails, what capability does the remaining RMP normally retain?
C23-004.answer: Control of all VHF and HF transceivers
C23-004.explanation: The remaining RMP normally controls all VHF and HF transceivers. The FCOM notes a VHF 3/ACARS exception when RMP 3 is not installed.
C23-004.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-20 · PDF p.1064 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.12

C23-005.question: What happens when the RMP transfer key is pressed?
C23-005.answer: The ACTIVE and STBY/CRS frequencies interchange and the receiver tunes the new active frequency
C23-005.explanation: The transfer key swaps the ACTIVE and STBY/CRS entries and tunes the receiver to the new ACTIVE frequency.
C23-005.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-20 · PDF p.1065 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.11

C23-006.question: How do the concentric RMP frequency selector knobs divide the tuning task?
C23-006.answer: The outer knob selects whole numbers and the inner knob selects decimal fractions
C23-006.explanation: The outer knob changes the whole-number units and the inner knob changes the decimal portion of the standby frequency.
C23-006.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-20 and DSC-23-60-A · PDF pp.1066, 1116 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.11

C23-007.question: For an equipped HF transceiver, what is the normal mode and how is AM selected?
C23-007.answer: SSB is the default; press the AM pushbutton to select AM
C23-007.explanation: HF normally operates in single side-band mode. The AM pushbutton selects amplitude modulation when required.
C23-007.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-20 · PDF p.1066 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.11

C23-008.question: What is the effect of pressing the guarded NAV key on an RMP?
C23-008.answer: It enables RMP selection of navigation receivers and courses without changing communication-radio selections or frequencies
C23-008.explanation: The NAV key enables radio-navigation backup selection through the RMP and does not disturb communication-radio selections or frequencies.
C23-008.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-20 · PDF p.1066 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx pp.11, 12

C23-009.question: Which equipment is central to the flight-deck audio management system?
C23-009.answer: An Audio Management Unit and three Audio Control Panels, plus the associated audio sockets and controls
C23-009.explanation: The audio management system includes the AMU, three ACPs, station sockets, microphones, loudspeakers, PTT controls, and audio switching.
C23-009.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-30 · PDF p.1068 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.10

C23-010.question: If audio channel 1 or 2 fails because of its ACP or corresponding AMU channel, how can the crew restore that position’s audio functions?
C23-010.answer: Use the AUDIO SWITCHING selector to connect the affected position to the third audio channel
C23-010.explanation: The AUDIO SWITCHING selector lets the captain or first officer use the third ACP/audio channel after a channel 1 or 2 failure.
C23-010.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-30 and DSC-23-10-50 · PDF pp.1068, 1078 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.12

C23-011.question: Which system transmits, controls, and processes the cabin and service interphones, passenger address, and other cabin-system signals?
C23-011.explanation: CIDS controls and processes the cabin/service interphone, PA, and several other cabin-system functions.
C23-011.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-30 · PDF pp.1070, 1071 · page revision 22 MAY 24

C23-012.question: How much cockpit voice recording is retained by the CVR?
C23-012.explanation: The CVR retains only the last two hours of recording.
C23-012.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-40 · PDF p.1072 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.8

C23-013.question: When are passenger-address announcements recorded by the CVR?
C23-013.answer: When PA reception is selected on at least one Audio Control Panel
C23-013.explanation: The CVR records PA announcements when PA reception is selected on at least one ACP.
C23-013.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-40 · PDF p.1072 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.8

C23-014.question: After the last engine is shut down on the ground, how long does the CVR normally continue recording?
C23-014.answer: 5 minutes, provided the CVR jack is not used
C23-014.explanation: Automatic CVR recording continues until five minutes after the last engine shutdown, provided the CVR jack is not used.
C23-014.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-40 · PDF p.1072 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.8

C23-015.question: Under which conditions does holding the CVR ERASE pushbutton for 2 seconds erase the full recording?
C23-015.answer: The aircraft is on the ground and the parking brake is on
C23-015.explanation: CVR erase is enabled only on the ground with the parking brake on, after the ERASE pushbutton is held for two seconds.
C23-015.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-40 · PDF p.1073 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.8

C23-016.question: What conditions are required to activate the CVR test?
C23-016.answer: The CVR must be on, the parking brake on, and the CVR TEST pushbutton pressed and held
C23-016.explanation: Press and hold CVR TEST while the CVR is powered and the parking brake is on. GND CTL may be used to power the recorder on the ground when required.
C23-016.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-40 · PDF p.1073 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.8

C23-017.question: What does a flashing external-radio transmission key on an ACP indicate?
C23-017.explanation: An external VHF or HF transmission key flashes when an incoming SELCAL is received.
C23-017.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-50 · PDF p.1074 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-018.question: What does pressing the SELCAL/CALL RESET key cancel?
C23-018.answer: The cockpit buzzer associated with the call
C23-018.explanation: The SELCAL/CALL RESET key cancels the call buzzer.
C23-018.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-50 · PDF p.1075 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-019.question: What is the purpose of the ACP VOICE filter key?
C23-019.answer: To inhibit the commonly used VOR and ADF identification audio signals
C23-019.explanation: The VOICE filter inhibits the common VOR and ADF ident audio so voice messages can be monitored more clearly.
C23-019.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-50 · PDF pp.1075, 1076 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.12

C23-020.question: How does the ACP INT/RAD switch behave when held in RAD?
C23-020.answer: RAD is momentary and the switch returns to the off position when released
C23-020.explanation: RAD keys the boomset or oxygen-mask microphone through the selected transmission channel and springs back to off when released.
C23-020.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-50 · PDF p.1076 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.12

C23-021.question: How does the ACP INT/RAD switch behave when selected to INT?
C23-021.answer: It remains in INT until another switch position is selected
C23-021.explanation: INT activates the boomset or mask microphone for interphone use and remains selected until the crew selects another position.
C23-021.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-50 · PDF p.1076 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.12

C23-022.question: If the sidestick RADIO selector is pressed while the ACP INT/RAD switch is on INT, which function has priority?
C23-022.explanation: The sidestick RADIO selection has priority over the interphone function.
C23-022.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-50 · PDF p.1077 · page revision 22 MAY 24

C23-023.question: What does the cockpit loudspeaker volume knob not control?
C23-023.answer: The loudness of aural alerts and voice messages
C23-023.explanation: The knob adjusts radio-communication loudspeaker volume; it does not control aural-alert or voice-message loudness.
C23-023.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-50 · PDF p.1077 · page revision 22 MAY 24

C23-024.question: What is the correct audio-switching action after ACP 1 fails?
C23-024.answer: Select CAPT 3; the captain uses ACP 3 and AUDIO 3 XFRD appears in green
C23-024.explanation: CAPT 3 connects the captain’s acoustic equipment to the third occupant’s ACP. The green AUDIO 3 XFRD memo appears and the third occupant loses access.
C23-024.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-10-50 and DSC-23-50 · PDF pp.1078, 1115 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.12

C23-025.question: Where can the ground crew connect to the flight interphone?
C23-025.answer: At the FLT INT jack on the maintenance nose-landing-gear panel forward of the nose-gear bay
C23-025.explanation: The ground-crew FLT INT jack is on the maintenance nose-landing-gear panel forward of the nose-gear bay.
C23-025.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-10 · PDF pp.1080, 1082 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-026.question: Before transmitting on the flight interphone, which selection sequence is required?
C23-026.answer: Select the INT reception knob out, press the INT transmission key, then use a PTT switch or RAD
C23-026.explanation: The crew selects INT reception out and the INT transmission key, then keys the microphone with a PTT control or the RAD position.
C23-026.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-10 · PDF p.1082 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-027.question: How is cabin-interphone audio received and adjusted at an ACP?
C23-027.answer: Press and release the CAB reception knob to the out position, then rotate it for volume
C23-027.explanation: With the CAB reception knob out, its white light comes on and cabin audio is received; rotating the knob adjusts volume.
C23-027.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-20 · PDF p.1084 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-028.question: What occurs at a selected cabin station when the flight crew makes a normal call from the CALLS panel?
C23-028.answer: Two steady pink area-call lights, a CAPTAIN CALL message with a green light, and a high-low chime
C23-028.explanation: A normal cockpit-to-cabin call produces two steady pink lights, CAPTAIN CALL on the applicable AIP with a green light, and a high-low chime.
C23-028.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-20 · PDF p.1086 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-029.question: What does a flight-deck emergency call produce in the cabin?
C23-029.answer: Flashing pink lights at all area call panels, EMERGENCY CALL on all AIPs, and three high-low chimes
C23-029.explanation: The guarded EMER pushbutton flashes the pink area-call lights, displays EMERGENCY CALL on all AIPs, and repeats the high-low chime three times.
C23-029.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-20 · PDF p.1086 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-030.question: What flight-deck indications follow a cabin crewmember’s normal CAPT call?
C23-030.answer: ATT lights flash on all ACPs and a buzzer sounds unless inhibited for takeoff or landing
C23-030.explanation: A cabin CAPT call flashes the ATT lights on all ACPs and sounds a cockpit buzzer, which is inhibited during takeoff and landing.
C23-030.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-20 · PDF p.1088 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-031.question: What distinguishes a cabin EMER CALL on the flight deck?
C23-031.answer: The EMER ON light flashes white, CALL flashes amber, ATT flashes on all ACPs, and three buzzers sound unless inhibited
C23-031.explanation: A cabin EMER CALL flashes the EMER ON and CALL indications and all ACP ATT lights, with three consecutive buzzers unless takeoff/landing inhibition applies.
C23-031.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-20 · PDF p.1088 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-032.question: How many service-interphone jacks are included in the system described by the FCOM?
C23-032.explanation: The service-interphone system includes seven interphone jacks and an overhead OVRD switch.
C23-032.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-30 · PDF p.1090 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-033.question: When do the service-interphone jacks become available automatically after landing?
C23-033.answer: Ten seconds after landing, provided the landing gear is locked down
C23-033.explanation: Ground personnel can use the service-interphone jacks ten seconds after landing when the landing gear is locked down.
C23-033.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-30 · PDF p.1092 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.10

C23-034.question: How can service-interphone communication be enabled when the landing gear is not locked down?
C23-034.answer: Press the SVCE INT OVRD pushbutton
C23-034.explanation: The SVCE INT OVRD pushbutton enables service-interphone communication when the landing gear is not locked down, including the on-jacks condition described by the supplement.
C23-034.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-30 · PDF p.1092 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx pp.5, 10

C23-035.question: Which ACP selections are used by flight crew to transmit over the service interphone?
C23-035.answer: CAB reception knob out, CAB transmission key selected, then a PTT switch or RAD
C23-035.explanation: For service interphone through the audio system, select CAB reception out and CAB transmission, then key the microphone with PTT or RAD.
C23-035.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-30 · PDF p.1092 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.10

C23-036.question: What happens when the ground mechanic presses the COCKPIT CALL pushbutton?
C23-036.answer: MECH lights flash amber on the ACPs and a buzzer sounds; the buzzer stops on release and the lights time out after 60 seconds unless reset
C23-036.explanation: A ground-to-cockpit call flashes the ACP MECH indications and sounds the buzzer. Releasing the button stops the buzzer; unre-set lights extinguish after 60 seconds.
C23-036.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-30 · PDF p.1094 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-037.question: Which system hosts the passenger address function, and which flight-deck microphones may be used?
C23-037.answer: CIDS hosts it; boom/headset, hand, oxygen-mask microphones, or the cockpit handset may be used
C23-037.explanation: CIDS hosts the PA system. Flight crew can make announcements with boom/headset, hand, or oxygen-mask microphones, or with the cockpit handset.
C23-037.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-40 · PDF p.1096 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.10

C23-038.question: To make a PA announcement using a boom, mask, or hand microphone, what must the flight crewmember do?
C23-038.answer: Select the PA reception knob out and press and hold the PA transmission key; no separate PTT is required
C23-038.explanation: Select PA reception out and hold the PA transmission key while speaking. The PA key itself keys the microphone, so a separate PTT selection is not required.
C23-038.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-40 · PDF p.1097 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.10

C23-039.question: When does the PA IN USE light illuminate?
C23-039.answer: When PA is active from the cockpit, cabin, or a prerecorded announcement
C23-039.explanation: The PA IN USE light comes on for PA activation from the cockpit or cabin, including a prerecorded announcement.
C23-039.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-20-40 · PDF p.1098 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.10

C23-040.question: What should the crew do with an RMP that has failed?
C23-040.answer: Switch the affected RMP off; one remaining RMP can control all receivers
C23-040.explanation: The FCOM directs the crew to switch the affected RMP off. One remaining RMP can control all receivers.
C23-040.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-60-A · PDF p.1117 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.12

C23-041.question: Which statement describes VHF 1 in the emergency electrical configuration?
C23-041.answer: Only VHF 1 functions, and its tuning range is 118.000 to 136.975 MHz
C23-041.explanation: Only VHF 1 functions in the emergency electrical configuration. The installed VHF communication range is 118.000 to 136.975 MHz.
C23-041.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-30-10 · PDF p.1100 · page revision 22 MAY 24

C23-042.question: Which restriction applies when using an installed HF radio on the ground?
C23-042.answer: HF must not be used during refueling or fuel-transfer operations
C23-042.explanation: The FCOM prohibits HF use during refueling or fuel transfer and requires people to remain clear of the antenna vicinity.
C23-042.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-30-10 · PDF p.1100 · page revision 22 MAY 24

C23-043.question: When is the SELCAL aural warning inhibited?
C23-043.explanation: The aural SELCAL warning is inhibited during takeoff and landing; the system otherwise advises the crew aurally and visually.
C23-043.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-30-10 · PDF p.1101 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.9

C23-044.question: On an aircraft equipped with SATCOM, what happens to ATSU or ACARS data when VHF 3 is unavailable?
C23-044.explanation: ATSU or ACARS normally uses VHF 3 and automatically changes to SATCOM when VHF 3 is unavailable.
C23-044.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-30-20-10 · PDF p.1102 · page revision 22 MAY 24

C23-045.question: How is the optional SATCOM cockpit voice interface normally controlled?
C23-045.answer: The ACP controls call setup and termination, while the MCDU selects the call number
C23-045.explanation: For SATCOM cockpit voice, the ACP controls call setup/termination and the MCDU is used for call-number selection.
C23-045.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-30-20-10 · PDF p.1102 · page revision 22 MAY 24

C23-046.question: With CAPT & PURS selected, what happens when an evacuation is initiated from the cabin?
C23-046.answer: The cockpit EVAC light flashes and the cockpit horn sounds continuously; cabin EVAC lights flash and the evacuation tone sounds continuously
C23-046.explanation: In CAPT & PURS, a cabin command can initiate the alert: the cockpit EVAC light flashes and horn sounds continuously, while cabin lights flash and the tone sounds continuously.
C23-046.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-40-10 · PDF pp.1110, 1111 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.7

C23-047.question: What is the function of the HORN SHUT OFF pushbutton on the evacuation panel?
C23-047.answer: It silences the cockpit horn generated by a cabin-initiated evacuation alert
C23-047.explanation: HORN SHUT OFF silences the cockpit horn produced by a cabin-initiated evacuation alert; it is not the master cancellation for the other indications.
C23-047.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-40-10 · PDF p.1111 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.7

C23-048.question: In ARMED, which emergency frequencies does the ELT transmit on after an impact?
C23-048.explanation: In ARMED, impact activation causes the ELT to transmit on 121.5, 243, and 406 MHz.
C23-048.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-40-30 · PDF p.1112 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.7

C23-049.question: If the ELT is triggered unintentionally while ARMED, how is it reset?
C23-049.answer: Select TEST/RESET to reset the ELT and stop transmission
C23-049.explanation: Selecting TEST/RESET resets an inadvertently triggered ELT and stops its transmission; the same position starts the ELT autotest.
C23-049.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-40-30 · PDF p.1112 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.7

C23-050.question: What does the green ACARS CALL memo indicate?
C23-050.answer: ACARS has received a ground message requesting voice communication on VHF
C23-050.explanation: ACARS CALL appears when ACARS receives a ground message requesting VHF voice communication; it pulses green for 60 seconds and then remains steady.
C23-050.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-50 · PDF p.1114 · page revision 22 MAY 24

C23-051.question: When should VHF 3 be used for voice communication if ACARS is installed?
C23-051.answer: Only when VHF 1 and VHF 2 are inoperative
C23-051.explanation: VHF 3 normally supports ACARS data. Use it for voice only when VHF 1 and VHF 2 are inoperative because voice mode temporarily removes the ATC datalink connection.
C23-051.ref: Ansett A320 FCOM DSC-23-60-A · PDF p.1118 · page revision 22 MAY 24 · Doc1.docx p.11
